<description>
Follow-up to #36164, as suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36164#issuecomment-5541268260.

Tracked in https://github.com/kevkevinpal/bitcoin/issues/550.

**Problem:** `MakeByteSpan` and `MakeUCharSpan` return views into their input. A temporary container can leave those views dangling.

**Fix:** Add `LIFETIMEBOUND` to the overload taking non-`borrowed_range` types, so Clang diagnoses the misuse on owning containers without flagging correct code that passes a view. `leveldb::Slice` is opted into `borrowed_range` so `dbwrapper` can keep using the helper. Matching the `util/string.h` helpers from #36164.
</description>

<commits>
eed5d00a0d span: rename UCharSpanCast to UCharCast

It is only used by MakeUCharSpan, and is the span counterpart of the
pointer UCharCast overloads. No behavior change.

aa4bbd0c9b span: diagnose dangling views from MakeByteSpan/MakeUCharSpan

Follow-up to #36164. Add LIFETIMEBOUND on the non-borrowed-range
overloads so Clang diagnoses storing spans of temporary owning
containers, matching the util/string.h helpers.

Also annotate the span overload of UCharCast, so the lifetime is not
lost when casting an already borrowed span, e.g.
UCharCast(MakeByteSpan(v)).
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/dbwrapper.cpp b/src/dbwrapper.cpp
index 7406cecca9..dee23f5333 100644
--- a/src/dbwrapper.cpp
+++ b/src/dbwrapper.cpp
@@ -32,8 +32,15 @@
 #include <cstdio>
 #include <memory>
 #include <optional>
+#include <ranges>
 #include <utility>
 
+// leveldb::Slice is a non-owning view into memory owned by the iterator, so a
+// temporary Slice does not leave the span below dangling. Opt it into
+// borrowed_range so that MakeByteSpan does not treat it as an owning container.
+template <>
+inline constexpr bool std::ranges::enable_borrowed_range<leveldb::Slice> = true;
+
 static auto CharCast(const std::byte* data) { return reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data); }
 
 bool DestroyDB(const std::string& path_str)
diff --git a/src/span.h b/src/span.h
index c3b22f43e2..2f8c701474 100644
--- a/src/span.h
+++ b/src/span.h
@@ -7,10 +7,13 @@
 
 #include <cassert>
 #include <cstddef>
+#include <ranges>
 #include <span>
 #include <type_traits>
 #include <utility>
 
+#include <attributes.h>
+
 /** A span is an object that can refer to a contiguous sequence of objects.
  *
  * Things to be aware of when writing code that deals with spans:
@@ -81,10 +84,17 @@ T& SpanPopBack(std::span<T>& span)
 }
 
 template <typename V>
+    requires std::ranges::borrowed_range<V>
 auto MakeByteSpan(const V& v) noexcept
 {
     return std::as_bytes(std::span{v});
 }
+template <typename V>
+    requires(!std::ranges::borrowed_range<V>)
+auto MakeByteSpan(const V& v LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
+{
+    return std::as_bytes(std::span{v});
+}
 template <typename V>
 auto MakeWritableByteSpan(V&& v) noexcept
 {
@@ -105,9 +115,14 @@ template <typename B>
 concept BasicByte = requires { UCharCast(std::span<B>{}.data()); };
 
 // Helper function to safely convert a span to a span<[const] unsigned char>.
-template <typename T, size_t N> constexpr auto UCharSpanCast(std::span<T, N> s) { return std::span<std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(UCharCast(s.data()))>, N>{UCharCast(s.data()), s.size()}; }
+template <typename T, size_t N> constexpr auto UCharCast(std::span<T, N> s LIFETIMEBOUND) { return std::span<std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(UCharCast(s.data()))>, N>{UCharCast(s.data()), s.size()}; }
 
 /** Like the std::span constructor, but for (const) unsigned char member types only. Only works for (un)signed char containers. */
-template <typename V> constexpr auto MakeUCharSpan(const V& v) -> decltype(UCharSpanCast(std::span{v})) { return UCharSpanCast(std::span{v}); }
+template <typename V>
+    requires std::ranges::borrowed_range<V>
+constexpr auto MakeUCharSpan(const V& v) -> decltype(UCharCast(std::span{v})) { return UCharCast(std::span{v}); }
+template <typename V>
+    requires(!std::ranges::borrowed_range<V>)
+constexpr auto MakeUCharSpan(const V& v LIFETIMEBOUND) -> decltype(UCharCast(std::span{v})) { return UCharCast(std::span{v}); }
 
 #endif // BITCOIN_SPAN_H

</patch>
